reviewer: session author; not an independent or native-language review
method: Read each candidate's full English, Tagalog and Cebuano body against the scored claim. Shared fact IDs are retrieval leads only.

accepted.conditions_note: All three bodies say plastic does not decompose easily and can persist. This supports ordinary-plastic persistence; no absolute never-degrades claim is accepted.
All three bodies explicitly describe wind moving leaves. Only that claim is linked; the separate generalized cooling statement is not certified by this review.
All three bodies identify wearing hand-me-down clothing as reuse for the same purpose, matching another child continuing to wear the shirt.
All three bodies explicitly associate vagina with birth canal and a passage for birth. The scored claim identifies this part; it does not assert that every birth is vaginal.

accepted.narrowed_knowledge_claim: Recalls that waves transfer energy from one place to another.
accepted.conditions_note: All three bodies explicitly teach energy transfer by waves. The assessment claim is narrowed to the keyed energy answer; selecting it does not separately establish understanding of every particle-motion detail in the explanation.
All three languages explicitly say that the cell membrane controls what enters and leaves a cell. The material-composition statement is not separately assessed.

All three bodies name tissue and say similar cells work together on one job, with specialized muscle tissue as the example. This supports the cell-cooperation definition, not the separate mastery of all organizational levels.
All three bodies explicitly name a community as populations of different species sharing one area. The keyed term and the different-population condition are both present.
The organ example explicitly says the heart pumps blood in all three languages. The existing Grade 4 recall item can be linked to this Grade 7 shelf exposure without relabeling it as Grade 7 mastery.

All three bodies directly contrast population with community and identify the latter as different populations living together in one place. Another encounter route to the same item/family, not another question.
All three bodies explicitly identify the biosphere with every place on Earth where living things exist. The geographic examples illustrate that scope; no requirement to recall their names is added.
All three bodies explicitly list carbon dioxide as an input required to make food through photosynthesis. The gas is the only required recalled answer, not a complete balanced equation.
All three bodies explicitly say plants release oxygen during photosynthesis. The item asks that product; it does not assess whether all atmospheric oxygen comes from land plants.

All three bodies give glucose plus oxygen producing carbon dioxide and water, with energy released. The item explicitly limits its question to complete aerobic glucose respiration; the oxygen/glucose condition is present in this teaching equation.

All three bodies explicitly say green plants make their own food through photosynthesis using sunlight. This is the keyed reason in the producer question; the question itself supplies the producer label. It does not ask the learner to generate an untaught label.

All three bodies identify sunlight energy used by plants in photosynthesis and stored in sugar. This supports the existing sunlight energy-source claim. Grass is the question’s ordinary green-plant context, not a newly assessed classification target.

All three bodies explicitly locate named photosynthetic light reactions in chloroplasts. This supports the narrow chloroplast/photosynthesis answer for the question’s leaf setting. The water-splitting wording and ATP explanation are not assessed or certified by this link review.

rejected.reason: Absolute do-not-break-down wording is less defensible than the tested do-not-decay-easily claim.
Lists nonliving sky objects; does not teach the tested plant-as-living example.
Chicken/egg example does not name reproduction, while the question requires that named process.
Omits the tested push-direction condition. A generic push does not necessarily increase speed.
Repurposing clothing as cleaning rags is a different example from passing clothing to another wearer.
Describes rocky composition but does not name the four planets required by the keyed answer.
Names an evacuation-center location but does not explicitly teach the route component of the compound scored answer.
Names water as nonliving but does not teach the tested word abiotic. Do not supply an untaught vocabulary equivalence through a topic link.
Teaches guard cells opening stomata after taking up water, but the recorded target claims both opening and closing. The closing action is absent.
Says to use fine focus at high power but does not explicitly teach the small-focus-changes property in the recorded claim. Kept as a lead rather than extending the exact claim.
Describes a stiff rectangular outer wall but does not explicitly teach its supporting role and location outside the membrane together. The existing question tests that compound description.
Contrasts stiff plant outer walls with animal membranes, but does not explicitly establish the supporting layer outside the plant cell membrane required by the current item.
The English says oxygen is made, while the Tagalog/Cebuano phrasing does not clearly preserve that production relation. Not accepted as trilingual evidence for oxygen production.
Says chloroplasts make food from sunlight, water and air but does not name photosynthesis, which is the scored answer. A different card explicitly names the process.

Explicitly discusses most DNA in eukaryotic nuclei, but does not identify ordinary human cheek cells as that cell type. Kept as a lead rather than assuming the learner already knows the extra classification bridge.

limitations: 17 accepted item-card links are not that many additional questions or evidence of typical coverage.
The initial five-link review found no exact trilingual body duplicates among additional cards sharing those source fact IDs. Later semantic links are separately documented manual decisions.
Snapshots and excerpts establish traceability; mechanical checks cannot verify the author's semantic judgment.

review_history.note: Initial manual teaching-link review retained in the accepted and rejected lists.

review_history.method: Prioritized Grade 7/8 actual lesson shelves with three existing families. Read candidate full English/Tagalog/Cebuano bodies against the exact target and keyed answer. Explicit manual decisions only; scripts attach snapshots and count proposed coverage.
